description: This file contains the implementation of the 'ModuleMerger' class in C++, responsible for merging various type and function representations within a linker module context. It handles merging built-in, user-defined, and referenced types, as well as functions and global variables, ensuring proper dependency management and duplicate detection.

classes.name: ModuleMerger
classes.description: Manages merging of types, functions, and global variables in a linker module context, handling dependency resolution, duplicate detection, and ODR (One Definition Rule) compliance.
